title: Add MealPlan Domain Types
description: Create the public `MealPlan`, `MealPlanBlock`, `MealPlanSection`, `MealPlanItem`, `MealPlanRecipe`, and `MealPlanIngredient` types, including the computed `dayOrdinal` behaviour and initialisers required by the spec.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlan.swift` defines all public meal plan value types with `Sendable` and `Equatable` conformance.
`MealPlanBlock.dayOrdinal` returns the captured non-negative integer only for headings matching `^Day\s+(\d+)$`.
Public initialisers match the spec and allow empty metadata/blocks defaults where required.
